heading: Applicability of other laws
lead: Chapter 10 of title 5 shall not apply to the Commission.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 206 of Pub. L. 105–292 was renumbered section 209 and is classified to section 6436 of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2022—Pub. L. 117–286 substituted “Chapter 10 of title 5” for “The Federal Advisory Committee Act (5 U.S.C. App.)”.
